LESSON: LISTENING AND SPEAKING 12.1.1 LISTENING TO RESPOND: VIEWS/ OPINIONS

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade seven
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 12
Topic 12.1: Listening and Speaking 12.1.1 Listening to Respond: Views/ Opinions
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Listening and Speaking 12.1.1 Listening to Respond: Views/ Opinions, part of Strand 12 in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade seven ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: How are opinions expressed? 2. Why is it important to express one’s opinion? 3. How can expressing opinions/views affect relationships?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Listening and Speaking 12.1.1 Listening to Respond: Views/ Opinions together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Learning to learn: A learner discusses various views/opinions.

● Digital literacy: A learner interacts using technology when searching online and listening to an oral narrative from

digital gadgets with assistive technology.

Values:
● Respect: A learner express opinions during group activities.

● Unity: A learner engages in group work.

Link to other subjects:

Views or opinions are important in subjects like Religious Education, Life Skills Education, and Music

Suggested Learning Resources

Digital devices with assistive technology, Manilla papers, felt pens, braille paper, braille machine
